targets.rawSql:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (stack, slice, kind)
       stack, slice, kind, verdict, partial, forced,
       started_at, finished_at,
       EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (finished_at - started_at)) AS duration_seconds,
       product_version, eval_set_version, run_id
FROM eval_runs
ORDER BY stack, slice, kind, started_at DESC

panels.title: Last run per suite and kind

targets.rawSql:
SELECT started_at AS time, slice AS metric,
       CASE WHEN partial THEN -1 WHEN verdict = 'pass' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS verdict
FROM eval_runs
WHERE stack = 'production' AND kind = 'nightly'
  AND $__timeFilter(started_at)
ORDER BY started_at

WITH family_rows AS (
    SELECT r.run_id, r.started_at, r.verdict,
           e.metrics->>'family' AS family,
           e.metrics->>'role' AS role,
           e.metrics->>'class' AS door_class,
           e.metrics->>'stream' AS stream,
           e.metrics->'checks' AS checks,
           e.metrics->>'problem' AS problem,
           e.metrics->'frontend'->>'class' AS frontend_class,
           e.metrics->'frontend'->>'agrees' AS frontend_agrees
    FROM eval_runs AS r
    JOIN eval_results AS e ON e.run_id = r.run_id AND e.run_started_at = r.started_at
    WHERE r.stack = 'production' AND r.kind = 'nightly' AND r.slice = 'guardrails'
      AND $__timeFilter(r.started_at)
      AND e.metrics->>'family' IN ('deadline-trap', 'guidelines-range', 'sentence-credit')
)
SELECT started_at, family, run_id, verdict AS run_verdict,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (
           WHERE role = 'positive' AND door_class IS NOT NULL
             AND NOT (
                 door_class IN ('replaced', 'declined', 'disclaimed')
                 OR (door_class = 'answered' AND (
                     checks->>'must_not' = 'true'
                     OR checks->'must_not' IS NULL
                 ))
             )
       ) AS positives_not_blocked,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (
           WHERE stream = 'leak' OR door_class = 'leak' OR frontend_class = 'leak'
       ) AS leaks,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE problem IS NOT NULL) AS errors,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE role = 'control' AND door_class = 'replaced') AS replaced_controls,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE frontend_agrees = 'false') AS frontend_disagreements,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE role = 'control') / 20 AS ceiling
FROM family_rows
GROUP BY started_at, run_id, verdict, family
ORDER BY started_at DESC, family

SELECT r.started_at, r.run_id, r.verdict AS run_verdict,
       e.metrics->>'family' AS family,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (
           WHERE e.metrics->>'role' = 'control'
             AND e.metrics->>'class' = 'declined'
       ) AS harness_declined,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (
           WHERE e.metrics->>'role' = 'control'
             AND e.judge->>'withheld' = 'true'
       ) AS judge_withheld,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (
           WHERE e.metrics->>'role' = 'control'
             AND e.metrics->>'class' IN ('declined', 'disclaimed')
             AND e.judge->>'withheld' IS NULL
       ) AS judge_unread
FROM eval_runs AS r
JOIN eval_results AS e ON e.run_id = r.run_id AND e.run_started_at = r.started_at
WHERE r.stack = 'production' AND r.kind = 'nightly' AND r.slice = 'guardrails'
  AND $__timeFilter(r.started_at)
  AND e.metrics->>'family' IN ('deadline-trap', 'guidelines-range', 'sentence-credit')
GROUP BY r.started_at, r.run_id, r.verdict, e.metrics->>'family'
ORDER BY r.started_at DESC, family

SELECT started_at AS time, slice AS metric,
       EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (finished_at - started_at)) / 3600.0 AS duration_hours,
       9 AS night_hours
FROM eval_runs
WHERE stack = 'production' AND kind = 'nightly'
  AND $__timeFilter(started_at)
ORDER BY started_at

WITH newest AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (slice) run_id, started_at, slice
    FROM eval_runs
    WHERE stack = 'production' AND kind = 'nightly'
    ORDER BY slice, started_at DESC
)
SELECT n.slice, n.run_id, e.case_id, e.repeat,
       e.metrics->>'family' AS family,
       e.metrics->>'role' AS role,
       e.metrics->>'class' AS class,
       e.metrics->>'problem' AS problem
FROM newest AS n
JOIN eval_results AS e ON e.run_id = n.run_id AND e.run_started_at = n.started_at
WHERE e.verdict = 'fail'
ORDER BY n.slice, e.case_id, e.repeat

panels.title: Failed cases of newest nightly runs

targets.rawSql:
SELECT tally.at AS instant,
       (tally.detail->>'fired')::integer AS fired,
       (tally.detail->>'refused')::integer AS refused,
       CASE WHEN (tally.detail->>'refused')::integer > 0
            THEN 'incomplete' ELSE 'complete' END AS completeness,
       trigger_row.entry->>'id' AS id,
       trigger_row.entry->>'state' AS state,
       trigger_row.entry->>'detail' AS detail
FROM (
    SELECT at, detail
    FROM audit_log
    WHERE kind = 'proposals_tally'
    ORDER BY at DESC
    LIMIT 1
) AS tally
LEFT JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(tally.detail->'triggers') AS trigger_row(entry) ON true
ORDER BY id NULLS LAST
